t0002-01.gloss: A clean bandage and sealed kit remain with an erased identity.
t0002-01.rival_reading: A sealed kit could have been carried away from an exposure site before anyone opened it; an unnamed label does not establish a failed transfer.

t0002-02.gloss: A water mark and plant trace were collected together.
t0002-02.rival_reading: A responder could collect water and leaves while checking an evacuation route; the residue could be ordinary field dirt.
